text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both gaining ground with ETH outpacing BTC slightly, suggesting appetite for altcoin exposure alongside the major assets. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 63 and has ticked up over the week, reflecting growing confidence, while Bitcoin dominance holding near 60% indicates the rally is broad-based rather than concentrated in BTC alone. Volume remains elevated at nearly $139 billion in 24h trades, supporting the move as more than a thin-air bounce.
